snapshots: These observer files were saved during the original run. They are not a new replay and are not marked derived.
c100_first_init: M47_CANDIDATE/observer/.../C100_{1001,1002}_X/001 is the only saved init for each C100 candidate world.
rc100_last_init: RC100 1001 step 009 and RC100 1002 step 011 are the last saved init directories.
visible_context: VISIBLE_CONTEXT.pkl is the saved visible tuple (instance, physical, algorithm, plan, start state, ground-required set, budget kwargs). It has no flags field.
